work.summary: Stabilize OPS10B1 Today task visibility on real devices and simplify per-task visit completion.
completed: Visit task confirmation now has one completion action: 訪問を完了.
Only checked tasks are completed for the current machine; unchecked tasks remain unfinished.
Per-task overall progress strings were removed from the visit dialog.
Today machine cards now render all linked unfinished task names compactly instead of two rows plus +N.
Today card task rendering is re-applied after the normal Today render lifecycle to avoid disappearing until a later rerender.
Standalone Today important-task block remains removed.
APP version and version.json were advanced to FINAL.13.
Guarded maintenance static gates passed before merge.
Production deployment for FINAL.13 reached READY.
Fresh mobile cloud smoke load of production returned HTTP 200 and rendered the application.

openItems: Final smartphone confirmation that task names are visible immediately on Today cards and the visit dialog has one completion button.
nextAction: After the smartphone confirmation passes, mark OPS10B1 fully confirmed and advance to OPS10B2 demand-transfer analysis.
